newsitem.title: USA: Melee breaks out at California racetrack.
newsitem.headline: Melee breaks out at California racetrack.

text.p: A melee broke out at a California racetrack between hundreds of spectators, apparently members of rival car clubs, authorities and local radio reports said Sunday.

About 70 law enforcement officers and a sheriff's department helicopter were dispatched late Saturday to the Sears Point Raceway in Sonoma, about 30 miles north of San Francisco, to break up the fight, which reportedly involved more than 500 people, authorities said.

A Sonoma County sheriff's department statement said the crowd was dispersed and the race, attended by more than 5,000 spectators, was closed down. Two people were treated at a local hospital for minor injuries.

Sonoma sheriff's department Lt. Chuck Laver said authorities do not know how or why the fight started. But local radio stations reported that the melee was sparked by a disagreement between rival drag racing car clubs.
The Sears Point Raceway is operated by Speedway Motorsports Inc.
